job.title: Senior Backend Engineer
job.description: We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build payment services in C# and .NET. You will design REST APIs, work with PostgreSQL, ship services in Docker containers, and improve our CI/CD pipelines. Experience with microservices and mentoring other engineers is required. Kafka is a plus.

profile.headline: Principal engineer, payments
profile.summary: Engineer with 15 years of experience building payment and healthcare systems in C# and .NET.
